hero.headline: Madison Arndt
body: I’m a developer who builds modular, functional systems designed to be both independent and scalable. I focus on creating tools and projects that can stand on their own while also supporting larger ecosystems.
Outside of coding, I stay active in the outdoors: walking, biking, hiking, and kayaking and I run a free outdoor exercise group in Anoka County and surrounding areas.

sections.title: About Me
body: I’m a developer with a strong focus on modular design and adaptability. I build projects in structured components so they can be reused, expanded, or integrated without unnecessary complexity. My approach keeps systems lightweight, maintainable, and practical for real world use.

One of the ways I stand out is how I adapt my syntax and structure to match existing repositories and environments. Instead of forcing a single style, I prioritize consistency within each project, making collaboration and long term maintenance easier.

Beyond development, I value staying active and connected. I regularly spend time outdoors and lead a free community exercise group, combining structure, consistency, and accessibility principles I also apply in my technical work.
I aim to build things that are useful, reliable, and easy to work with. whether for myself, a team, or a larger system.

sections.title: Professional Skills
body: I am proficient in Python and several C-family programming languages, with the ability to read and understand code across programming languages even when I have not worked extensively with the specific language.
My technical experience includes database design, software development, automation, troubleshooting, and basic IT setup and support.
I currently work with CODESYS and Python, and have experience working with e!COCKPIT, JMobile, Galileo, and LOGO! Soft Comfort.
I also use AI-assisted development to help build foundations and accelerate development, while taking care to remove sensitive information before providing material to AI systems.

sections.title: Professional Experience
body: I have worked at Broadway Equipment Company since 2018, where my responsibilities have expanded significantly over time.

I began by converting machine code from one development platform to another and gradually took on broader programming responsibilities. I am currently responsible for machine-related programming and serve as the lead developer for the company's updated wash control systems.
My work includes machine programming, system development, data analysis, and relay and control systems.

sections.title: Education
body: I earned an Associate of Arts (AA) and an Associate of Science (AS) from Anoka-Ramsey Community College, attending from 2017 to 2023.
I later earned a Bachelor of Science (BS) from St. Cloud State University, attending from 2023 to 2026.

sections.title: Community & Volunteer Experience
body: I run Prism Bloom Exercise (PBE), a free outdoor exercise community focused on creating accessible opportunities for people to stay active through activities such as walking, hiking, biking, and kayaking.
I also serve on the Anoka County 4-H Management Committee and as foreman and coordinator for Anoka County 4-H Waste Education.
Waste Education provides 4-H youth from sixth grade through one year after high school with opportunities to earn money toward their 4-H program fees through community waste education work.
